text:
Hannah T: quick follow-up from the postmortem — repeated pages at 03:10 were correlated with the nightly sync job. goal: reduce pager churn while keeping signal.
Diego M: yep. noise came from many identical signatures across hosts. we should add signature dedupe + a small backoff.
Riley P: i can own the backoff and signature work. propose: collapse identical-signature alerts within 3m, then suppress further pages for 25m, but escalate if a different signature appears.
Hannah T: good. keep suppression conservative. add whitelist for deploy and DB migrations.
Riley P: plan sketch (alert pipeline):
```
alert: sync_job_latency_spike
expr: avg_over_time(sync_job_latency_seconds[2m]) > 1.2
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: paged
annotations:
  signature: "{{ $labels.job }}:{{ $labels.host }}:{{ $labels.step }}"
```
Dedup rule: collapse on annotations.signature, consolidation_window=3m, suppression=25m, escalate_on_new_signature=true.
Diego M: i'll do threshold analysis for the job metrics — 30d p95 vs p99 and propose where to move. i'll include expected page delta and FN risk. target: 48h.
alerts-bot: (automated) Incident#5310 resolved by hannah.t  follow-up task 'sync-job-pager-reduction' created
Hannah T: owners & timeline:
- Riley P: dedupe + backoff impl, staging tests & PR  due 2025-02-06
- Diego M: threshold analysis PR + dashboard updates  due 2025-02-05
- Hannah T: canary schedule, runbook blurb, and rollback playbook  due 2025-02-07
Riley P: will implement dedupe in router for now (per-job). if we see cross-job storms later we can consider global router-level dedupe.
Diego M: suggestion: tag tuned alerts with label "patterned-flap-feb2025" and surface that label in Slack notif for 10 days so oncall knows it's tuned.
Hannah T: agreed. also add a short banner text in alert body that points to the follow-up task and runbook.
ops-queue: (automated) Task created: sync-job-pager-reduction assigned to [Riley P, Diego M, Hannah T] due 2025-02-07
Riley P: will exclude suppression during deploy-tagged events by checking deploy labels on the alert envelope. will post PR link here.
Diego M: i'll attach trend CSV, expected reduction %, and a small heatmap of hosts so we can see whether to tune per-host or per-job.
Hannah T: also instituting a biweekly 3-alert sweep for 6 weeks to catch regression. volunteers?
Diego M: i'll take weeks 1 and 4.
Riley P: i'll take weeks 2 and 5.
Hannah T: please reply 'ack' after you've added cards to the project board and linked PRs to this thread. i'll move tasks to In Progress once linked.
Diego M: ack  adding PR link soon.
Riley P: ack  will link staging logs & PR here.
Hannah T: thanks. final note: keep suppression conservative and prefer label-driven temporary suppression for scheduled jobs over global silence. will brief oncall before canary. :thumbsup:
